hits.title: SAP to acquire Reltio: make SAP and non-sap data ai-ready.
hits.snippet: WALLDORF & REDWOOD CITY - SAP SE (NYSE: SAP) and Reltio Inc. today announced that SAP has agreed to acquire Reltio, a leading master data management (MDM) software provider, to help customers make their SAP and non-SAP enterprise data AI-ready.
